high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from wired.com, displaying an article about the LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory) machine. The text describes the extensive development process of the LIGO machine, which took decades to design and construct. It mentions that construction began in 1994 and took more than 20 years, including a four-year shutdown to improve the detectors. The article highlights the detection of the first gravitational wave by LIGO in 2015, which was a ripple in the space-time fabric caused by the collision of two black holes.
